verses.devanagari: ॥ श्रीगुरु चरन सरोज रज निज मनु मुकुरु सुधारि ॥
verses.transliteration: shree guru charana saroja raja nija manu mukuru sudhaari
verses.meaning: Cleansing the mirror of my mind with the sacred dust of the Guru's lotus feet...

verses.devanagari: ॥ बरनउँ रघुबर बिमल जसु जो दायकु फल चारि ॥
verses.transliteration: baranau raghubara bimala jasu jo daayaku phala chaari
verses.meaning: I recount the pure glory of the Lord of Raghu dynasty, bestower of life's four fruits...

verses.devanagari: ॥ बुद्धिहीन तनु जानिके सुमिरौ पवन कुमार ॥
verses.transliteration: buddhi heena tanu jaanike sumirau pawana kumaara
verses.meaning: Knowing my intellect to be lacking, I meditate upon you, O Son of the Wind...

verses.devanagari: ॥ बल बुधि बिद्या देहु मोहि हरहु कलेस बिकार ॥
verses.transliteration: bala budhi bidya dehu mohi harahu kalesa bikaara
verses.meaning: Bestow strength, wisdom, and clarity; remove all distress and afflictions.
